name: clients
description: CRM for the owner's freelance/business clients: per-client isolated memory (profile, notes, thread summaries, invoices, deals), context loading before any reply is drafted (never answer from another client's context), sentiment flagging that routes angry/urgent clients to the owner instead of auto-replying, follow-ups, and a dashboard. Sending anything to a client is ALWAYS confirmed (T2) - drafts only, no auto-send, no exceptions.
route: new client, client profile, read my client messages, load client context, draft a reply to a client, client follow up, deal summary, invoice status, client dashboard, client notes, new client inquiry
